report.summary: Patient P-D012 (age 47, Medicaid via Lakeshore Community Health Plan, transport benefit yes) screened today with unmet transportation need and lives in tract 17031230500 (32.6% of households no vehicle; 47 transit stops within 800 m with early service; 100% low-income area). Meds are low-cost (insulin glargine pen $2/mo, gabapentin $1/mo, no refill gaps), but he asked for med-cost help. Two recent appointments (podiatry 9/14 no-show; primary care 10/22 kept) have no facility location on file, so transit feasibility could not be computed. Eligibility: Medicaid Ride Line — eligible as a Medicaid plan member (call number on card ≥2 business days ahead); Paratransit/ADA certification — possible (apply by phone, decisions up to 21 days); Senior Shuttle West — NOT eligible (age 60+ required, patient is 47). Med-cost options: Clinic Rx Fund (short-term copay help for current patients), Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program application help), and prescription savings card signup (form-based, response within 1 business day).

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Call the number on the Medicaid member card at least 2 business days before the appointment to schedule a non-emergency medical ride. Benefit confirmed under Lakeshore Community Health Plan.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; allow up to 21 days for a decision.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides (7 AM–5 PM) for adults 60+ to medical appointments. Patient is 47, so NOT eligible.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay assistance for current patients of this clinic; ask clinic staff to apply.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) and manufacturer patient-assistance programs; ask clinic staff or pharmacist for a referral.

options.name: Prescription savings card signup
options.how_to_access: Complete the savings-card form to check what the patient qualifies for; response within one business day.
